Excellent food and services
Oct 2026 • Friends
I had such a great experience at this restaurant. The food was truly delicious—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. Every bite felt carefully made, and the portion size was just right. It’s clear the kitchen takes pride in quality and consistency.

What made the visit even better was the service. A special thank-you to **Vinh**—he was friendly, attentive, and genuinely kind. He made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal, checked in at the right times, and provided helpful recommendations. His professionalism and warm attitude made us feel welcomed from the moment we arrived.

The whole experience—from the food to the service—was excellent. I will definitely come back, and I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great food and a staff that truly cares.
